method: Custom CUDA-event stage stream spans plus Python cProfile; not hardware occupancy or pure GPU busy time
overlap_rule: Parent spans include children. Use exclusive spans or independent stage categories; summed device time is not wall time across GPUs.

devices.stream_timing_semantics: CUDA stream elapsed including host launch gaps; not pure kernel busy time
devices.exclusive_semantics: Inclusive duration minus direct nested children; sum exclusive values to avoid double count.
devices.coverage: Only wrapped resident methods and explicit kernels; external scheduling, filtering and file I/O are covered only by optional host profiling.

conclusion: Region pruning and object prediction/visibility dominate. Cooperative matching and output writing are small in these measured workloads.
limits: Native array kernels and external scheduling are outside custom-kernel counters; profile method and cold/setup conditions differ from the earlier shared-GPU3 timing. NPZ write timers exclude device-to-host copies, profiling JSONL and other JSON/progress I/O. cProfile reports host-call elapsed, including waits, not CPU-busy cycles. Instrumentation overhead is measurable; full profiling samples every tenth batch.
